title: Bazu Terror
summary: Defeat Bazu Terror and its crushers to expose the dark animist.
overview: Defeat Bazu Terror and its crushers to expose the dark animist.

sections.title: Encounter strategy
bullets: The eligible beastlord starts the event through Jillaa Oogblat.
Be ready for four bazu crushers alongside the boss.
Bazu Terror's death summons the dark animist at its position.
The bazu stage has a thirty-minute appearance window.
